notes: A hanging entity of the fall/hang pool (FH_KNOT, lane/ride): spawned at a fence by ItemLead or by a reloaded mob's recreateLeash, tracked to the client as S0E type 77 (pickobj.c PK_KNOT), dropped at chunk unload. lead-s1: tie, unload, reload (the knot is rebuilt from the cow's Leash tag), untie. lane/idxentity: interactFirst's creative branch is not reachable in survival play, so the record is exact over what play reaches. lane/reloadstate: leash-reload-s1 unloads a cow tied to a knot and relinks it (coverage, passed on master).
